sessions.text: {"packets":[{"id":"build-adoption-map","purpose":"Read the four frozen sources (install.mjs, package.json, HOSTS.md, MAINTENANCE.md) and write adoption-map.json containing exactly the four objects install, package, support, maintenance with only the required fields, source-grounded values, '/' paths, no trailing slashes on install destinations (piPrimary keeps integrations/pi/), and all arrays string-sorted and deduplicated.","constraintIds":["preserve"],"inputs":[{"path":"install.mjs","required":true,"delivery":"indexed"},{"path":"package.json","required":true,"delivery":"inline"},{"path":"HOSTS.md","required":true,"delivery":"indexed"},{"path":"MAINTENANCE.md","required":true,"delivery":"indexed"}],"dependsOn":[],"writeScope":["adoption-map.json"],"deliverables":[{"path":"adoption-map.json"}],"checks":[{"id":"verify-adoption-map","text":"adoption-map.json contains exactly the four objects install/package/support/maintenance with every required field; every value is derivable from the four sources (installer facts from install.mjs, package fields from package.json, tested/support status from HOSTS.md without treating compatibility as tested, maintenance rules from MAINTENANCE.md); paths use '/', install destinations have no trailing '/', piPrimary keeps the source's integrations/pi/; all arrays are ascending-sorted and duplicate-free; the four source files remain byte-identical and nothing else is written.","criterionIds":["accurate-map"]}],"unknowns":["install.mjs as frozen appears to start mid-function at 'const results = []' with no imports or host-validation code visible; accepted --host values, default host, destinations and marker are therefore grounded in its help text plus the HOSTS.md host table — the executor should re-verify the full file length before finalizing the install object."]}]}
